projects.title: Payment Service with Idempotency, Transactional Outbox and Kafka
projects.description: A payment API that never takes a payment twice and never loses the event that tells settlement about it.
objectives: Make POST /payments idempotent under concurrent retries
Solve the dual-write problem with a transactional outbox
Consume at-least-once events idempotently, with a dead-letter topic

projects.title: Multi-Currency Wallet on a Double-Entry Ledger, with FX Transfers
projects.description: Wallets that cannot overdraw, deadlock or drift from the ledger, including GBP to EUR transfers at a quoted rate.
objectives: Post balanced journal entries with ordered pessimistic locking
Enforce ledger invariants in the database (balance, append-only)
Model a 4-leg FX transfer and reconcile balances against postings

projects.title: Card Authorisation and Clearing with a Fraud Hook and Resilience
projects.description: Authorise, capture, reverse, refund and charge back card payments, with a fraud check protected by timeout, circuit breaker and bulkhead.
objectives: Implement the card lifecycle as a state machine over sealed types
Protect concurrent captures with optimistic locking and @Retryable
Call a fraud engine with timeout, circuit breaker, bulkhead and an explicit fallback

projects.title: Settlement and Reconciliation Pipeline (CAMT.053 ingest, matching, breaks)
projects.description: Ingest bank statements safely, match them against the ledger, classify every difference and resolve it through an audited workflow.
objectives: Parse ISO 20022 camt.053 statements safely (no XXE) and validate balances
Match bank lines to ledger items and classify breaks
Run a maker-checker exception workflow with an append-only audit trail

projects.title: Instant P2P Transfer API with OAuth2, Per-Tenant Rate Limiting and Webhooks
projects.description: A multi-tenant transfer API secured by OAuth2, kept fair with a Redis token bucket, notifying tenants through signed, retried webhooks.
objectives: Secure a resource server with JWT audience, scope and object-level checks
Rate-limit per tenant with an atomic Redis token bucket
Deliver signed webhooks with leases, backoff with jitter and SSRF protection
